governing_rule: no food security by benefit row

FOOD-01.fail_or_repair: Open a participant-continuity docket and downgrade program rows to denominator evidence.
FOOD-01.label: Participant and household identity
FOOD-01.question: Does the packet bind household, child, infant, pregnancy/postpartum category, disability, language, homeless/custody/care/school status, tribal/rural edge, and representative authority before accepting a food-assistance status?

FOOD-02.fail_or_repair: Treat eligibility/approval as incomplete until clock and notice records are joined.
FOOD-02.label: Eligibility and clock integrity
FOOD-02.question: Can application, expedited SNAP, recertification, WIC certification, direct certification, verification, notice, and appeal clocks be reconstructed?

FOOD-03.fail_or_repair: Do not count issued benefits as food access until card and transaction usability are proven.
FOOD-03.label: Issuance and spendability
FOOD-03.question: Is the benefit actually spendable through EBT/eWIC card/PIN/account, issuance date, online purchase, POS, replacement-card, and transaction evidence?

FOOD-04.fail_or_repair: Downgrade retailer locators to access denominators until reachable food is proven.
FOOD-04.label: Retailer and food availability
FOOD-04.question: Does retailer evidence show authorized store, distance, stock, formula/food package, price, transport, disability access, delivery/online route, and rural/tribal availability?

FOOD-05.fail_or_repair: Treat WIC participation/category rows as incomplete until service and redemption records are joined.
FOOD-05.label: WIC service delivery
FOOD-05.question: Does the WIC lane prove certification appointment, nutrition-risk assessment, eWIC issuance, food package/formula, breastfeeding support, referrals, proxy pickup, and redemption?

FOOD-06.fail_or_repair: Do not treat reimbursement or plan rows as child nutrition without child-level meal or benefit evidence.
FOOD-06.label: Child meals and summer gap
FOOD-06.question: Are school breakfast/lunch, CACFP, SFSP, Summer EBT, special diets, school closure, meal-service days, direct certification, and child-level receipt joined?

FOOD-07.fail_or_repair: Treat disaster waivers as authority only until survivor food receipt and logistics are proven.
FOOD-07.label: Disaster and emergency nutrition
FOOD-07.question: Does the packet join D-SNAP, replacement, hot-food, USDA Foods, destroyed food, power outage, retailer operations, shelter/mobile distribution, and transport?

FOOD-08.fail_or_repair: Do not call integrity successful until false-positive and unrepaired-theft harms are visible.
FOOD-08.label: Theft, fraud, and integrity harm
FOOD-08.question: Are stolen benefits, card skimming/cloning, replacement authority, fraud holds, overissuance, trafficking controls, notice, appeal, and household repair separated?

FOOD-09.fail_or_repair: Publish residual hunger and access gaps instead of treating program participation as outcome proof.
FOOD-09.label: Outcome and equity denominator
FOOD-09.question: Does the packet separate participation/spending from food insecurity, missed meals, diet quality, disability, language, child, older adult, tribal/rural, shelter/custody/care, and transportation effects?

FOOD-10.fail_or_repair: Mark federal sources as posture/denominator and require live state/school/clinic/processor records for decisions.
FOOD-10.label: Source currentness and role boundary
FOOD-10.question: Are USDA/FNA/ERS pages, program data, timeliness tables, dashboards, guidance, waivers, and local records separated by source role and review clock?
